description: Source code for handling ubus requests, including reference resolution, response preparation, and event handling in a network device context.

methods.name: add_linker_entry
methods.description: Adds a linker entry to the context's linker list.

methods.name: free_linker_entries
methods.description: Frees all linker entries in the context's linker list.

methods.name: fill_blob_param
methods.description: Fills a blob buffer with path, data, and type information.

methods.name: resolve_reference_path
methods.description: Resolves a reference path, possibly using linker list or micro-service data.

methods.name: prepare_and_send_response
methods.description: Prepares and sends a response based on the context's data.

methods.name: send_response
methods.description: Finalizes and sends the response, cleaning up event handlers and linker entries.

methods.name: get_results_array
methods.description: Extracts the results array from a blob message.

methods.name: append_response_data
methods.description: Appends response data from a blob message to the tracker context.

methods.name: handle_request_timeout
methods.description: Handles timeout for an asynchronous ubus request.

methods.name: ubus_result_callback
methods.description: Callback for processing ubus response messages.

methods.name: ubus_request_complete
methods.description: Handles completion of an ubus request.

methods.name: run_async_call
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous ubus call with provided context, object, and message.

methods.name: send_linker_cleanup_event
methods.description: Sends a linker cleanup event via ubus.

methods.name: linker_response_callback
methods.description: Handles linker response events, updating linker entries.
